title: U-AFS: Urgency-Aware Fair Scheduler for Mixed Real-Time and Best-Effort Traffic in IEEE 802.11 Wireless Networks
description: Simulation framework, test suites, and empirical evaluation data for U-AFS (Urgency-Aware Fair Scheduling) in IEEE 802.11 Wi-Fi networks. Includes implementations of U-AFS, IEEE 802.11e EDCA baseline, Deficit Round-Robin (DRR), Earliest Deadline First (EDF), Round-Robin (RR), SPSA parameter auto-tuning, closed-loop TCP Reno dynamics, OBSS interference modeling, and ns-3 CSMA/CA MAC/PHY validation.
